# HB Hub

> HB Hub is a student-made messaging site for students at HANSENBERG Tekniske Gymnasium (HTX) in Kolding, Denmark: class group chats and DMs, a casino with play chips that aren't real money (Blackjack, Baccarat, Roulette), and games (Matador, chess, UNO, Wordle and Ore Mining Inc.). It runs in the browser, in English.

Most of the site needs an account; the pages below can be read without one. Casino chips are not money: they can't be swapped for real money or anything else, and nothing won can be paid out. HB Hub is a free student project, made and run by one student, not by the school.

## Free games (no account needed)

- [Free games](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/play): Every game that can be played without an account.
- [Wordle](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/play/wordle): Guess the day's five-letter word in six tries, in English or Danish.
- [Ore Mining Inc.](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/play/ore-mining-inc): An idle clicker: mine an asteroid, build a mining company and prestige across the multiverse.
- [Blackjack](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/play/blackjack): Beat the dealer without going over 21. Double, split and insurance, with play chips.
- [Baccarat](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/play/baccarat): Bet on Player, Banker or a tie in punto banco, with play chips.
- [Roulette](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/play/roulette): Spin a single-zero wheel and bet straight on the board, with play chips.

## Help docs

- [Help & docs](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/): Everything HB Hub can do, and how to use it.
- [Getting started](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/getting-started): Making an account, logging in and finding your way around HB Hub.
- [Profile & settings](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/account): Your profile picture, name and bio, your password, your devices and deleting your account.
- [Two-factor login & security](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/two-factor): Turning on two-factor login, logging in with Discord, the password rules and what happens after wrong guesses.
- [Notifications](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/notifications): The bell, browser notifications, the message sound and muting chats.
- [Blocking the Casino & Games](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/self-blocking): Blocking the Casino and Games for yourself, during school hours or all the time.
- [Feedback & getting help](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/feedback): Reporting bugs and people, sending ideas, and who to ask for help.

## Chat

- [Chat basics](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/chat/): DMs, message requests, replies, reactions, editing and deleting, pinned messages, and the chat menu.
- [Styling your messages](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/chat/formatting): Bold, italic, underline, code, headings, lists and links in your messages.
- [Group chats](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/chat/groups): Making a group, its owner and admins, nicknames, changing its name, icon and background, and your class chat.
- [Files & pictures](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/chat/attachments): Sending files and pictures, the picture viewer, and how attachment tickets work.
- [GIFs & smileys](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/chat/gifs): Sending GIFs from Giphy and smileys from the smiley menu.
- [@mentions](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/chat/mentions): Mentioning someone in a chat or a game chat, and who gets told.
- [Staying safe in the chat](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/chat/safety): Blocking people, link safety, the spam limit and reporting someone.

## Casino

- [How the casino works](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/casino/): Chips, the daily chips, tables and codes, leaderboards, and what chips are and aren't.
- [Blackjack](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/casino/blackjack): Beat the dealer without going over 21, solo or at a table with up to 5 players.
- [Baccarat](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/casino/baccarat): Bet on the Player, the Banker or a tie, solo or at a table with up to 6 players.
- [Roulette](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/casino/roulette): European roulette with a single zero, and every bet placed straight on the board.

## Games

- [How games work](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/games/): Opening a game, codes and invites, what the host can do, game chats and leaderboards.
- [Matador](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/games/matador): The Danish Monopoly for 2-4 players, with houses, hotels, trades and Prøv lykken.
- [Chess](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/games/chess): Two-player chess, with or without a clock, draw offers and rematches.
- [UNO](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/games/uno): The card game for 2-6 players, with stacking, catching and official scoring.
- [Wordle](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/games/wordle): Guess the day's five-letter word in six tries, in English and in Danish.
- [Ore Mining Inc.](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/docs/games/ore-mining-inc): A clicker game: mine an asteroid, build a mining company and prestige across the multiverse.

## Legal

- [Terms of service](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/legal/terms): The rules for using HB Hub: your account, how to behave in the chat, what the casino chips are, fair play and what happens if the rules are broken.
- [Privacy policy](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/legal/privacy): What HB Hub stores about you, why, who can see it, the cookies it uses and how to get your data deleted.
- [Code of conduct](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/legal/code-of-conduct): How we treat each other on HB Hub: in the chat, in groups, in the games and the casino, and how to report someone who crosses the line.

## Optional

- [Do not sell or share my personal information](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/legal/do-not-sell-or-share-my-personal-information): HB Hub never sells or shares your personal information, for advertising or anything else.
- [Credits](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/legal/credits): Credits for the third-party icons, code, lists and fonts used on HB Hub.
- [Sign up](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/onboarding): Making an account.
- [Log in](https://hbhub.noahgajnielsen.dk/login): Logging in.

## Crawling

- AI-Indexing: allowed
- AI-Training: not allowed
- Search-Indexing: allowed

## Avoid

- /admin
- /assets/php
- /cron
- /chat
- /gambling
- /games
